src/components/ui/spinner.tsx: The shared Spinner itself: the one component allowed to apply animate-spin to a pending indicator.
src/client/components/session-status-ico: Session tab status glyph: a loading, starting or stopping session spins its status-tone icon (beside the robot for agents); it is a status, not a pending control.
src/client/components/todo-item.tsx: Todo status ring: an in-progress task spins its bordered status ring, a status rather than a pending control.
src/client/features/workspace/workspace-: Workspace status badge: Setting up and Archiving spin their status glyph inside a labelled badge, a status rather than a pending control.
